source.description: The daily narrative was reorganized from the user's own spoken notes supplied in the conversation.

claims.claim: The user wants to get out of bed immediately after the alarm and brush teeth first.
The work system needs a more flexible spec.md entry, visible feedback changes, and recovery from a specific Skill after NG.
AI-assisted coding is reducing the user's sense of control and requires clearer evidence.
AI-generated repositories, blogs, problem sets, and PDFs have not all been deeply understood or internalized.
A useful learning loop is to question, recall, write, verify, and apply AI-generated material.
claims.notes: This is an organizing interpretation of the user's stated concern, not a direct quotation.
